<thought>To find a suitable retrosynthetic template for a carbonyl‑ene cyclization, I will search the template catalog using the plain (un‑mapped) SMILES of the target molecule and the functional‑group criteria “aliphatic hydroxyls” (broken) and “ketones” (formed). No bond specifications are needed.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC(C(F)(F)F)C1O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"],
  "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
